text: #351: At tick 11 the nearest trees were 21.2m(+135), 33.5m(+117), 42.4m(+135). By tick 955 (~19 game s, player never moved from 0,0) all three are gone; nearest tree now 54.1m. Pawns (100m+ away at start) or something else cleared the trees right by spawn before the player could reach them.

Objective 7 'Reach the Village era' progress bar text is clipped on the left: shows 'nbers 4/10 · Buildings 0/2' instead of 'Members 4/10 ...'. Also the Inventory panel jumped into the middle of the screen over the world after crafting the axe, and the Season panel overlaps the Player Info panel (Relationships line half covered) while inside a settlement.

Pressing K a second time ~4 s (wall) later, as a player would after reading the 'Press K again to build a House' prompt at 3-5 fps, just re-arms the confirm: status became 'Press K again... (x2)', '(x3)'. Only presses <1 s apart built the house. ConfirmGate window is 4 s of wall time, which at low fps is a few frames; the repeated-identical prompt gives no hint the window lapsed.

CRASH at tick ~25700 (Day 2 night): NullReferenceException in PawnBehaviorCalculator.computeBehaviorTypeInSettlementByDay line 223 (MERCHANT branch: market.getStall(pawn.getId()) is null, no null check unlike lines 75/125). I was standing in Cityfield's settlement gifting coins to its members, ~2700 ticks after poaching Oscar Jones from Cityfield with R. Game window vanished; crash report copied to crash1.txt. Lost progress since autosave at tick 24000. Screenshot is after 'pt start --continue'.
